description: Record a decision on a worker's evidence submission. Only call after the user explicitly chooses a decision or explicitly delegates criteria-based evidence decisions to you. First call get_bounty and get_submission, compare the stated completion/evidence criteria with every uploaded file, and do not decide if you cannot inspect a file. `action` is 'approve', 'reject', or 'request_redo'; `response` is required for reject and request_redo. Available while the job is evidence_in_review (the worker submitted evidence); other states return HTTP 409 job_state_conflict. Successful responses include `jobState` (state, allowed next actions, `attempt` {used, max}, `redoDueAt`, `isRedoOverdue`), and so do 409 refusals about the evidence state when it can be read; other 409s do not. After 3 redo cycles, HTTP 409 redo_limit_reached allows only approve or reject. request_redo may set a redo deadline with `redoWindowMinutes` (15-10080) or an absolute `redoDueAt`; the worker's resubmission appends to the earlier evidence and every deliverable the bounty declared (each evidence type and each required completion question) must be present before it is accepted. Before the deadline, reject from changes_requested or revision_in_progress returns HTTP 409 redo_deadline_pending; once overdue (`isRedoOverdue: true`), reject is available there too. Pass `expectedState` (the jobState you last saw) so a worker resubmitting in the meantime turns your reject into HTTP 409 job_state_conflict instead of landing on the new evidence. reject is final and files no dispute: the worker has 48 hours to appeal (rejection.disputeDeadline). Payment and seat stay held, then are refunded and released if no appeal. On HTTP 409 dispute_unavailable, retry reject or use request_redo. Automated `recommendation` and findings are advisory, never the verdict. Approving with bonusDecisions settles the bonus amounts immediately, and they can't be changed afterwards. Pay with release_payment (acknowledgeRelease: true). Owner only.

action.description: Review decision: 'approve' accepts the evidence, 'reject' declines it, 'request_redo' asks the worker to resubmit corrected evidence.

bonusDecisions.description: Approve only, for a seat with bonuses: how many items of each bonus were earned. A claimed bonus earns 0 to the claimed count; a bonus the worker did not claim may still be awarded, up to its maxUnits. reason is optional; if given, the worker sees it. Every bonus the worker claimed must appear: without bonusDecisions, or with a claimed bonus missing, the API returns HTTP 409 bonus_decisions_required and lists the missing ones in claimedBonuses (bonusId, title, unitAmountCents, maxUnits, claimedUnits, note), empty when nothing was claimed. An unclaimed bonus may be omitted and counts as 0. Unearned bonus money returns to your wallet when the bounty closes.

bonusId.description: The id of a bonus on this seat, claimed or not (from bonuses or claimedBonuses).

earnedUnits.description: How many items of this bonus were earned: 0 to the claimed count for a claimed bonus, or up to maxUnits for one the worker did not claim.
earnedUnits.title: between(0, 100)

reason.description: Note to the worker. reason is optional; if given, the worker sees it. Never sent in webhooks.
reason.title: maxLength(500)

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty the submission belongs to

expectedState.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard: the job state you last observed (e.g. 'changes_requested' when rejecting after a redo deadline). The review is refused with HTTP 409 job_state_conflict if the job has since moved, such as the worker resubmitting.

redoDueAt.description: request_redo only: absolute ISO-8601 redo deadline, between 15 minutes and 7 days from now. Mutually exclusive with redoWindowMinutes.

redoWindowMinutes.description: request_redo only: how long the worker has to add the requested evidence, in minutes (15-10080). Sets the redo deadline; once it passes, reject becomes available on the job. Mutually exclusive with redoDueAt.

response.description: Message shown to the worker. Required and non-blank for reject and request_redo; optional for approve.
response.title: maxLength(1000)

submissionId.description: The unique ID of the evidence submission to review

name: review_submission
title: Record evidence decision
